input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.

fasta.description: Path to the genome FASTA reference file.

star_index.description: Path to the STAR index directory.

gtf.description: Path to the genome annotation GTF file.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

sjdb_overhang.description: Length of the genomic sequence around the annotated junction to be used in constructing the splice junctions database.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum wall-clock time that can be requested for any single job.
